Container.Name: Fancyfin
Container.Overview: A modern, cinematic web client for Jellyfin. Point it at your existing Jellyfin server; the Jellyfin server itself is not changed. The :edge tag follows the latest development build.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Address of your Jellyfin server as reachable from this container, for example http://192.168.1.20:8096. Leave empty and Fancyfin asks for the address the first time you open it.

Config.Name: TMDB API key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. A TMDB API key or read access token. Turns on the 'popular right now' featured banner. It stays on the server and is never sent to the browser. Get one free at themoviedb.org.

Config.Name: Radarr URL (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Address of Radarr as reachable from this container, for example http://192.168.1.20:7878. With the key below, Jellyfin administrators get an Add to Radarr button on popular movies you don't have. Needs the Jellyfin URL above.

Config.Name: Radarr API key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. From Radarr, Settings, General. It stays on the server and is never sent to the browser.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Address of Sonarr as reachable from this container, for example http://192.168.1.20:8989. With the key below, Jellyfin administrators get an Add to Sonarr button on popular shows you don't have. Needs the Jellyfin URL above.

Config.Name: Sonarr API key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. From Sonarr, Settings, General. It stays on the server and is never sent to the browser.
